standard.summary: Anima 扩层后哪些参数参与训练：new_layers（默认，只训练新增层）、new_layers_periphery（新层+外围模块：输入、时间嵌入、最终输出层）、all（全部参数）。
standard.effect: new_layers 冻结全部原有层，只让零初始化的新层学习——最接近标准 Depth Up-Scaling；periphery 额外放开输入/时间嵌入/输出头以适配新深度；all 是全参微调。
standard.whenToUse: 标准 DUS 配方用 new_layers；发现新层学习受限于输入输出适配时升级到 periphery；数据充足、算力充裕、追求最大改造空间时用 all。
standard.avoidWhen: 扩层未开启时无效；all 范围在小数据集上极易灾难性遗忘原模型能力。

standard_en.summary: Which parameters train after Anima expansion: new_layers (the default, only the added layers), new_layers_periphery (the new layers plus the peripheral modules: input, time embedding, final output layer), all (every parameter).
standard_en.effect: new_layers freezes every original layer and lets only the zero-initialised new ones learn, which is closest to standard Depth Up-Scaling; periphery additionally unfreezes the input / time embedding / output head to adapt to the new depth; all is a full-parameter finetune.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use new_layers for the standard DUS recipe; move up to periphery if you find the new layers held back by input/output adaptation; use all when data and compute are plentiful and you want the most room to reshape the model.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No effect while expansion is off. The all scope catastrophically forgets the original model's ability on a small dataset.

advanced.principle: 扩层后的最优训练自由度是个层级：只训新层保证原能力零损失（原层参数字面不变）；外围模块是深度改变后最需要重校准的接口层；全参则把扩层当作普通微调的更大起点。
advanced.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_context.py：scope 归一化（new_layers/new_layers_periphery/all，enabled 时非法值抛错）；anima_depth_expansion_runtime.py：按 scope 设置 requires_grad 集合。
advanced.expectedImpact: new_layers 显存最省（优化器状态只覆盖新层）、行为最可控；all 显存与遗忘风险最大。
advanced.tradeoffs: 范围越大需要的正则与数据越多；periphery 是性价比折中，但输出头解冻后原模型的输出分布也开始漂移。

advanced_en.principle: Post-expansion training freedom is a hierarchy: training only new layers guarantees zero loss of original capability (original-layer parameters literally unchanged); periphery modules are the interface layers most needing recalibration after a depth change; all treats the expanded model as a bigger starting point for ordinary fine-tuning.
advanced_en.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_context.py: scope normalization (new_layers/new_layers_periphery/all; illegal values raise when enabled); anima_depth_expansion_runtime.py: sets the requires_grad set per scope.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: new_layers uses the least VRAM (optimizer state covers only new layers) and is the most controllable; all has the highest VRAM and forgetting risk.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Larger scopes need more regularization and data; periphery is the value-for-money compromise, but once output heads unfreeze the original model's output distribution starts drifting too.
advanced_en.codePath: config_adapter_conversion_context.py: train_scope validation; anima_depth_expansion_runtime.py: TRAIN_SCOPES and requires_grad partitioning
